name: B10-0424/2026 – After § 9 – Am 132/2
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the need for an EU strategy to counter Islamist entryism and the influence of the Muslim Brotherhood network
part_text: 9a. Underlines the urgent need to prevent and combat hate speech by Members of the European Parliament, including anti-migrant, anti-Muslim or other rhetoric against any religion that stigmatises and discriminates against people with a migrant background or of any faith; stresses that Members of the European Parliament have a responsibility to uphold the standards of conduct, dignity and mutual respect laid down in Parliament’s Rules of Procedure and Code of Conduct; calls on the President of the European Parliament to ensure the consistent, impartial and effective application of the relevant rules, including the effective investigation and sanctioning of conduct that breaches those standards;
